title: Beasts
description: Tooth, claw, scale, and horn - the creatures of the wildsea that hunt, scavenge, and defend their territory.
inPlay: Beasts work well as the centrepiece of an encounter, but they are rarely mindless. Give them drives, territory, and a reason to be where they are, and let the crew's approach to those drives shape the fight.

hazards.name: Bastions of Plant and Plate
hazards.summary: Pangoska: larger, ape-like cousins of the humble pangolin, with a physiology uniquely adapted to the vibrant and ever-changing ecosystem.

hazards.name: Swift Staccato Predators
hazards.summary: Pinwolves: vicious pack hunters with stiletto limbs that can climb any surface, closing off escape routes and setting ambushes.

hazards.name: Living Drilling-Rigs
hazards.summary: Thrummingbirds: large birds that pulverise the wood of tallshanks in search of sap, leaving destruction behind them.

hazards.name: The Hangman's Living Lash
hazards.summary: Jikari: frog-like lizards with wide mouths and long, dextrous tongues that spear unprepared prey from the high thrash.

hazards.name: Inquisitive Engineers
hazards.summary: Tinker-monkeys: clever scavengers of wreck-reefs and newly risen spits, as likely to be lemurs or apes, with a hankering for disassembly.

hazards.name: Rodent Replacement System
hazards.summary: Ratwork clusters: an unnatural collection of omnivorous rats driven to strip ship-parts and replace them with their own bodies.

hazards.name: Mutative Avian Horrors
hazards.summary: Manticrows: the undisputed kings of carrion, ranging from cat- to horse-sized, their feathers edged like blades.

hazards.name: Living Relics of Pre-Verdant Elegance
hazards.summary: Tryphoradon: a beast whose true origins are unknown, speculated to be a living relic of the pre-verdant world.

hazards.name: Vulture-Maned Scavengers
hazards.summary: Hideous half-bird creatures that prey on the dead and dying, agile climbers known to circle above the waves.

hazards.name: Slumbering Fruit-Eaters
hazards.summary: Axehead sloths: slow herbivores found hanging asleep in the tangle, hungry for fruit and nutritious bark when they wake.

hazards.name: Spine, Scale and Grease
hazards.summary: Spireback lenku: low, scaled beasts named for the mane of horny growths covering their shoulders and backs.

hazards.name: Many Limbs, Many Eyes
hazards.summary: Basilisks: multi-eyed lizards that nest near statuary and feast on stone, their chalk-like blood and soporific gaze both dangerous.

hazards.name: Avatars of Seething Simian Violence
hazards.summary: Makadrills: mask-wearing monkeys obsessed with mechanisms and machinery, willing to descend in a horde to steal a single piece of technology.

hazards.name: Enigmatic Reptilian Mimics
hazards.summary: Zenta: an oddity even by wildsea standards, a reptilian cuckoo that lays its eggs in another creature, the young growing into its shape.

hazards.name: Heralds of the Storm
hazards.summary: Ironjaw rays: huge, graceful, aloof creatures spotted sailing slowly through the skies before major storms.
